title.en: First steps: permissions, phone setup, theme
title.hi: Pehle steps: permissions, phone setup, theme
title.mr: Pahile steps: permissions, phone setup, theme

description.en: Your first steps in the Sales X-Ray app: allow notifications, set up this phone, and pick a theme in Settings, Phone and alerts.
description.hi: Sales X-Ray app mein shuruaat: notifications allow kijiye, phone set up kijiye, aur Settings ke Phone and alerts mein theme chuniye.
description.mr: Sales X-Ray app madhli suruvaat: notifications allow kara, phone set up kara, aani Settings chya Phone and alerts madhye theme nivda.

say.en: Your first steps in the app: permissions, setting up this phone, and choosing a theme.
say.hi: App में आपके पहले steps: permissions, phone setup, और theme चुनना.
say.mr: App मधले तुमचे पहिले steps: permissions, phone setup, आणि theme निवडणं.

latn.hi: App mein aapke pehle steps: permissions, phone setup, aur theme chunna.
latn.mr: App madhle tumche pahile steps: permissions, phone setup, aani theme nivadna.

say.en: Next: what to do if a screen ever hangs.
say.hi: अगले video में: अगर कोई screen अटक जाए तो क्या करें.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: एखादी screen अडकली तर काय करायचं.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: agar koi screen atak jaaye toh kya karein.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: ekhadi screen adakli tar kay karaycha.

text.en: New app? Do these 3 things first

say.en: Just installed Sales X-Ray? Do these three things first.
say.hi: Sales X-Ray अभी install किया? पहले ये तीन काम कीजिए.
say.mr: Sales X-Ray आत्ताच install केलं? आधी ही तीन कामं करा.

latn.hi: Sales X-Ray abhi install kiya? Pehle yeh teen kaam kijiye.
latn.mr: Sales X-Ray aattach install kela? Aadhi hi teen kaama kara.

say.en: When you first open the app, Android asks to send you notifications. Tap Allow, so you hear about new leads and replies.
say.hi: पहली बार app खोलते ही Android notifications की permission माँगता है. Allow दबाइए, ताकि नए leads और replies की ख़बर मिले.
say.mr: पहिल्यांदा app उघडल्यावर Android notifications ची permission मागतो. Allow दाबा, म्हणजे नवीन leads आणि replies ची खबर मिळेल.

latn.hi: Pehli baar app kholte hi Android notifications ki permission maangta hai. Allow dabaiye, taaki naye leads aur replies ki khabar mile.
latn.mr: Pahilyanda app ughdlyavar Android notifications chi permission maagto. Allow daba, mhanje navin leads aani replies chi khabar milel.

say.en: Then Set up this phone walks you through the rest, one line at a time. Each line's fix is one tap away.
say.hi: फिर Set up this phone बाकी सब एक एक line करके करवाता है. हर line का fix बस एक tap दूर है.
say.mr: मग Set up this phone बाकी सगळं एक एक line करून करून घेतो. प्रत्येक line चा fix फक्त एका tap वर आहे.

latn.hi: Phir Set up this phone baaki sab ek ek line karke karwata hai. Har line ka fix bas ek tap door hai.
latn.mr: Mag Set up this phone baaki sagla ek ek line karun karun gheto. Pratyek line cha fix fakta eka tap var aahe.

say.en: Pick a theme in Settings, under Phone and alerts. System follows your phone, or choose Light or Dark.
say.hi: Settings में, Phone and alerts के अंदर theme चुनिए. System आपके phone जैसा रहता है, या Light या Dark चुनिए.
say.mr: Settings मध्ये, Phone and alerts मध्ये theme निवडा. System तुमच्या phone सारखा राहतो, किंवा Light किंवा Dark निवडा.

latn.hi: Settings mein, Phone and alerts ke andar theme chuniye. System aapke phone jaisa rehta hai, ya Light ya Dark chuniye.
latn.mr: Settings madhye, Phone and alerts madhye theme nivda. System tumchya phone sarkha rahto, kinva Light kinva Dark nivda.

say.en: Turn vibration on or off here. Alert sounds follow your phone's own settings.
say.hi: Vibration यहीं on या off कीजिए. Alert sounds आपके phone की settings के हिसाब से चलते हैं.
say.mr: Vibration इथेच on किंवा off करा. Alert sounds तुमच्या phone च्या settings प्रमाणे चालतात.

latn.hi: Vibration yahin on ya off kijiye. Alert sounds aapke phone ki settings ke hisaab se chalte hain.
latn.mr: Vibration ithech on kinva off kara. Alert sounds tumchya phone chya settings pramane chaltat.

say.en: And everything about the app on this phone sits right here, in one place.
say.hi: और इस phone पे app से जुड़ी हर चीज़ यहीं है, एक ही जगह.
say.mr: आणि या phone वरच्या app बद्दल सगळं इथेच आहे, एकाच ठिकाणी.

latn.hi: Aur is phone pe app se judi har cheez yahin hai, ek hi jagah.
latn.mr: Aani ya phone varchya app baddal sagla ithech aahe, ekach thikani.
